packages.name: retroarch
packages.versionModel: official buildbot stable directory listing; regex provider reads /stable/<version>/ and renders the Windows x86_64 archive URL
packages.publisherCheck: buildbot publishes no checksum file (RetroArch.7z.sha256 returns 404), so the digest is an independent download hash registered in the manifest; the updater re-downloads and re-hashes before publishing any later version

commandModel.verified: retroarch.exe --version prints `RetroArch - Frontend for libretro` / `Version: 1.22.2 (Git 69a4f0e)` both natively and through `piko __shim retroarch`

stateModel.reason: RetroArch resolves these defaults relative to the application directory (`:\saves`, `:\states`, `:\screenshots`, `:\system`, `:\cores`, `:\playlists`, `:\thumbnails` in frontend/drivers/platform_win32.c). Without a link into persist, an upgrade to a new version directory would strand the user's saves, states, BIOS files and downloaded cores.
stateModel.configTemplate: retroarch.cfg is generated with savefile_directory, savestate_directory, screenshot_directory, system_directory, libretro_directory, playlist_directory and thumbnails_directory pointing at {{persist}}; the installer writes it as a regular file, not a hardlink, because config_file_write() stages a `.tmp` beside the target and renames over it (libretro-common/file/config_file_io.c), which would break a hardlink on the first in-place save.
stateModel.notPersisted: info/ is shipped in the payload (core metadata for the bundled version). Persisting it would shadow every later release's metadata with the previous release's files, so it stays version-local.
stateModel.notOwned: RetroArch's own config_save_on_exit rewrite of retroarch.cfg inside the install directory, and any user-chosen content or core download directories outside the package tree.

isolatedInstall.pikoHome: .cache/verify-home with a local HTTP source copy
isolatedInstall.files: 14,808 payload files; every declared persist path materialised as a junction into persist/retroarch/<name>
isolatedInstall.generatedConfig: retroarch.cfg present at the install root with all seven directory keys resolved to the persistent tree

packages.name: ares
packages.versionModel: official GitHub release tag v148; the nightly pre-release channel is excluded by the version and asset regexes
packages.publisherCheck: GitHub release asset digest sha256:fa97958e... is byte-identical to the independent download

commandModel.verified: ares.exe --version prints `v148` natively and through `piko __shim ares`

stateModel.reason: ares resolves settings.bml through locate(), which checks the application directory first (desktop-ui/desktop-ui.cpp) and writes it with nall file mode::write, i.e. fopen("wb+") truncating in place (nall/nall/file-buffer.hpp). A hardlink therefore survives the rewrite. Systems/ holds user-dumped firmware and defaults to Path::user()/Emulation/Systems/ but is honoured from the application directory when present.
stateModel.notOwned: Any Systems path the user points at a different location, and per-system save files that default to the game path.

isolatedInstall.files: 4,971 payload files; Systems/ is a junction and settings.bml is a hardlink (verified identical inode in apps/ and persist/)

packages.name: mgba
packages.versionModel: official GitHub release tag 0.10.5; the asset regex matches only the win64 7z, so the installer EXEs and the medusa preview archives cannot be selected
packages.publisherCheck: the 0.10.5 release assets carry no GitHub digest; the manifest value is an independent download hash and the updater re-downloads and re-hashes before publishing

stateModel.reason: the archive ships an empty portable.ini, so mCoreConfigPortablePath() (src/core/config.c) resolves the config directory to the executable directory. ConfigurationWrite() opens with O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC (src/util/configuration.c), which rewrites the existing inode, so config.ini can be a hardlink.
stateModel.notPersisted: qt.ini is QSettings output written through a temporary rename; a hardlink would be replaced on the first save and Piko would then refuse the drifted mapping, so it stays version-local.
stateModel.notOwned: ROM files, and any savestate/screenshot/patch directory the user repoints in the GUI.

isolatedInstall.files: 67 payload files; config.ini shares an inode with persist/mgba/config.ini, savestates/screenshots/cheats are junctions

packages.name: medusa
packages.versionModel: official prerelease tag medusa-a2 (published 2017-04-26); this is the final Windows x64 preview of mGBA's DS emulator
packages.discovery: regex over https://mgba.io/downloads.html for `medusa-<tag>-win64.7z`; the generic `medusa-build-latest-win64.7z` development archive is not matched
packages.publisherCheck: no publisher digest exists for this 2017 asset; the manifest value is an independent download hash

stateModel.persist: none declared; medusa predates any documented portable mode
stateModel.note: medusa.exe is a GUI application with no version flag: launching it opens a window, so the automated check stops at the payload digest and layout. The strip prefix embeds the build date and cannot be templated, which is why the recipe carries a literal prefix.

isolatedInstall.files: 32 payload files installed and verified by checksum

packages.name: shadps4
packages.versionModel: official GitHub release tag v.<version>; the Pre-release-shadPS4-<date>-<sha> nightly tags are excluded
packages.publisherCheck: release assets carry no GitHub digest; the manifest value is an independent download hash

commandModel.verified: `piko __shim shadps4 --help` prints the upstream `shadPS4 Emulator CLI` usage
commandModel.reason: with no arguments the CLI only shows a message box pointing at the Qt launcher and prints help (src/main.cpp), so the desktop shortcut opens Big Picture mode

stateModel.reason: UserPaths is built from `current_path()/user` when that directory exists (src/common/path_util.cpp, PORTABLE_DIR = "user"), and every data subdirectory (log, screenshots, shader, game_data, sys_modules, patches, cheats, cache, home, trophy, custom_configs, ...) is created beneath it. Persisting that one root covers settings, keys, firmware modules, patches and per-game configs together.
stateModel.notOwned: Games and the firmware modules the user must dump from their own console.
stateModel.notPackaged: The official QtLauncher lives in a separate repository (shadps4-emu/shadps4-qtlauncher) and is not part of this package.

isolatedInstall.files: single 60,364,288-byte shadPS4.exe; user/ materialised as a junction into persist/shadps4/user

packages.name: vscode
packages.versionModel: official update API `productVersion`; the URL template pins the version-specific portable archive endpoint
packages.publisherCheck: the API's `sha256hash` field for the archive channel is byte-identical to the downloaded file

commandModel.reason: the ZIP ships only bin/code.cmd for the CLI and Piko native mappings must target .exe/.com, so `code` is a PowerShell entry point that forwards to the shipped wrapper; `code-gui` starts the editor directly
commandModel.verified: `bin\code.cmd --version` prints 1.145.2 / c4453f8ea430795f941c1b2ff6c9321135a74a02 / x64, and the generated piko-code.ps1 wrapper produces the same output under -ExecutionPolicy Bypass
commandModel.executionPolicyNote: the host machine has script execution disabled, so an unrestricted PowerShell shim launch is refused by Windows itself; this is a host policy, not a package defect, and no policy was changed

stateModel.reason: portable mode on Windows is enabled by the presence of a `data` directory beside Code.exe (official Portable mode documentation); user-data, extensions and shared storage all land under it
stateModel.notPersisted: the archive's own appx/, policies/ and tools/ helpers stay version-local
stateModel.notOwned: a pre-existing %APPDATA%\Code installation; this package does not migrate or take it over
stateModel.autoUpdate: the ZIP build has no auto update, so Piko owns the version

isolatedInstall.files: 3,280 payload files; data/ materialised as a junction into persist/vscode/data
isolatedInstall.portableModeConfirmed: Code.exe created data/shared-data/sharedStorage/state.vscdb and data/user-data/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb inside the junction target, i.e. in persist
